header: What's new in Microsoft Secure Score
content:
Article • 05/01/2024
To make Microsoft Secure Score a better representative of your security posture, we
continue to add new features and improvement actions.
The more improvement actions you take, the higher your Secure Score will be. For more
information, see Microsoft Secure Score.
Microsoft Secure Score can be found at https://security.microsoft.com/securescore
in
the Microsoft Defender portal.
The following recommendation is added as a Microsoft Secure Score improvement
action:
Microsoft Defender for Identity:
Edit insecure ADCS certificate enrollment IIS endpoints (ESC8)
The following recommendations have been added as Microsoft Secure Score
improvement actions:
Microsoft Entra (AAD):
Ensure 'Phishing-resistant MFA strength' is required for Administrators.
Ensure custom banned passwords lists are used.
Ensure 'Windows Azure Service Management API' is limited to administrative roles.
Admin Center:
Ensure 'User owned apps and services' is restricted.
Microsoft Forms:
Ensure internal phishing protection for Forms is enabled.
Microsoft Share Point:
Ensure that SharePoint guest users cannot share items they don't own.
